variants.tabular_nums: Use tabular-nums class for order ages, quantities, prices, and timestamps.

colors.semantic_backgrounds: Use light tints of status colors with WCAG AA contrast. Color never carries meaning without text or iconography.

layouts.main_content: Max reading column 760px; Dense tables full width
layouts.top_bar: Includes sidebar toggle, global search (/ shortcut), Create menu, integration-health indicator, notifications, user menu.

grids.dashboard_overview: Mode B: High Density Grid. Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6. Use col-span logic for main charts and summary metrics.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle shadows for cards, 1px solid borders. Do not use glassmorphism for operational health/data apps. Use flat solid surfaces instead.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton for tables and data arrays using 1px border.default (#D8E0E8).

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements (buttons, table rows, cards). Subtle lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow increase on actionable cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: background-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease). Do NOT use 'transition: all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use semantic text/iconography alongside colors.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='order-table-row', data-testid='global-search-input').

component_guidelines.buttons: Primary (brand.primary background, text-white), Secondary (surface.default background, border.default, text.primary), Quiet (transparent background, text.secondary, hover:surface.subtle), Danger (status.danger text/border). Height: 36px or 40px.
component_guidelines.status_chip: Pill shape (rounded-full), includes icon + text, uses status colors.
component_guidelines.severity_indicator: Small semantic dot or icon mapping to status.danger/warning/info.
component_guidelines.data_table: Dense tables, full width. Include saved views, 44px or 52px row height, sticky header. Columns include severity, reason, owner, etc.
component_guidelines.drawer: Right-side detail drawer for Work Queue and Order detail. width ~360px-400px.
component_guidelines.inbox_workspace: 3-pane case workspace: conversation list (320px), thread + composer, context pane (360px).
component_guidelines.toast: Use sonner for toast with undo functionality.

icons.usage: Use crisp, standard icons (strokeWidth={2}). Use specific semantic icons for status (CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, XCircle, Info).

image_urls.description: Professional user headshot for header and table owner columns.
Professional user headshot for Inbox or chat threads.
Electronics gadget for order items and inventory lists.
Warehouse shelves for empty state graphics or fulfillment overview background.

instructions_to_main_agent.priority: Strict adherence to the provided UX/UI specifications. Treat the spec as the single source of truth.
instructions_to_main_agent.customization: Customize Shadcn UI components heavily to match the provided token values (colors, border-radius, spacing, typography). Do NOT use default Shadcn styling.
instructions_to_main_agent.mock_data: Implement realistic mock data for all unavailable backend/data sources (using the provided image URLs where applicable).
instructions_to_main_agent.architecture: Use a clean data layer that can be swapped out for real APIs later.
instructions_to_main_agent.file_type: Generate .js and .jsx files (not .tsx) as requested in the rules.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.1: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this by using the precise tight layout, tabular numeric variants, and exact neutral color palette to make it feel like a professional 'logistics control room' rather than a generic SaaS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.2: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but do NOT use glassmorphism for this operational app. Rely on crisp 1px borders and distinct solid neutral backgrounds (canvas vs default vs subtle).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.3: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.4: You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts reading flow.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.5: Always use crisp, functional button styles (6px radius) relevant to the app style.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.6: NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react standard icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.7: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Ensure active states are clearly visible with high contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.8: Use generous spacing where appropriate, but respect the 44px/52px row density limits for tabular data.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.9: Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.10: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but strip any 'default SaaS' styles to match the custom tokens.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.11: Use sonner for toasts, locate it in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (adjusting for JS extension).
